messages:
olivia: Heads-up: we’re publishing a deprecation timeline for the v1 SDK and a docs refresh that includes a migration guide. Read the plan and flag anything that impacts customers.
mike: Thanks — is this only for the JS/Python SDKs or all official client libs?
olivia: All official clients (js, python, go). We’ll keep runtime compat shim for 6 months but will remove legacy sync APIs earlier.
priya: Quick note: breaking changes include renaming `model` -> `model_id`, and switching streaming chunks to newline-delimited JSON objects instead of array batches.
darren: Could you paste the old vs new example for streaming? That will help eng support and sample apps.
olivia: Sure. Old streaming (v1):
```
// v1 example
client.stream({ model: "rwd-3b", prompt: "hi" })
.on('data', chunk => { /* chunk is an array */ })
```
New streaming (v2):
```
// v2 example
client.stream({ model_id: "rwd-3b", prompt: "hi" })
.on('data', line => { /* line is NDJSON object */ })
```
priya: Also calling out auth header standardization: we’re moving from `Authorization: Bearer <key>` to requiring `x-redwood-key: <key>` for SDKs by default; legacy header will be accepted for 90 days then 410.
anna: Need to confirm if support tickets will be auto-mapped during transition — we get a bunch of customers hardcoding headers in infra. I’ll prepare a notice template.
mike: Do we have a migration helper script planned? Something to rewrite small apps quickly.
priya: Yes, there’s a CLI codemod in the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-migrations/pull/42 — it handles model->model_id and header rewrites for JS/Python.
darren: Are there perf regressions expected with the NDJSON streaming change? We need to notify infra and SRE if telemetry changes.
olivia: No perf regressions expected; actually less buffer churn for many clients. SRE, please monitor streaming-request-size and stream-latency for the rollout window.
docs-bot: Migration guide published: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrations/sdk-v1-to-v2 — includes code samples, codemod usage, and deprecation dates.
anna: Customer comms plan: draft email + in-console banner for orgs with heavy SDK usage. ETA for banners?\nmike: We can gate banners off a feature flag. I’ll queue a banner template for review by EOD tomorrow.
priya: Timeline summary: announcement today, codemod + docs live today, soft-deprecation (warnings) in 30 days, legacy header disabled in 90 days, full removal of sync APIs in 180 days.
olivia: Correct. If any team needs exceptions for enterprise customers, send PR to infra-policy with customer ID and proposed length.
anna: I’ll start drafting the customer notice and run it by legal.
darren: +1 to adding migration samples in the quickstarts repo — I’ll open a PR.
mike: Thanks all. I’ll coordinate the release notes and small changelog bullet points for the SDK releases page. :shipit
__notes: This file is a simulated Slack thread for internal SDK/docs deprecation announcement. Messages are short and realistic per agents.md rules. No title field included.
